title: Enable ALSA software mixing (dmix)
summary: Software mixing allows multiple applications to play sound simultaneously on cards that do not support hardware mixing. This is often needed for digital outputs like S/PDIF.

steps.explain: Restart applications using sound for the changes to take effect.

rollback.explain: Remove the added block from /etc/asound.conf or ~/.asoundrc.

warnings: Incorrect configuration can break audio output. Ensure you have a backup of your configuration file.
